notes.title: 🕊️ Pigeon Flight Simulator is now available!
notes.content:
🕊️ Pigeon Flight Simulator is Now Available!
Are you ready? The city sky is now your playground! 🌆

The highly anticipated Pigeon Flight Simulator has landed on Steam!
Fly freely over a vast city with this ultra-realistic pigeon flight simulator. No missions, no stress—just you, your wings, and a calming flight.

🎮 Key Features:
✔️ Wide city landscapes with detailed architecture
✔️ Realistic flight physics
✔️ A fully relaxing, mission-free experience
✔️ Special “Relaxing Fly Mode” to boost mental and emotional well-being
✔️ Soothing, custom-composed music

🧘‍♂️ Escape the stress of daily life, spread your wings, and enjoy the freedom.
Fly today, relax, and explore the city through the eyes of a pigeon!


Don’t forget to share your experience with us!
📸 Post your screenshots, videos, or peaceful moments with the community.

#PigeonFlightSimulator #SteamRelease #RelaxingGame #Simulation #FlyFree
